import trimesh, numpy as np, math
from manifold3d import Manifold, Mesh
w=trimesh.load('exports/model.wheel.675d7f4a.stl')
b=trimesh.load('exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl')
def to_manifold(tm):
    v=np.ascontiguousarray(tm.vertices, dtype=np.float32); f=np.ascontiguousarray(tm.faces, dtype=np.uint32)
    return Manifold(Mesh(vert_properties=v, tri_verts=f))
bm=to_manifold(b); wm=to_manifold(w)
gap=37.3333333
def overlap(m):
    wm2=wm.rotate([0,0,-gap+m]).translate([0,0,4])
    ov=bm ^ wm2
    return ov.volume(), ov.num_vert() if hasattr(ov,'num_vert') else ''
for m in [0,-5,-10,-13,-15,-17,-20,-25,-30,2,4,6,8,10,12,14]:
    v,n=overlap(m)
    print(m, round(v,4))
"
